notes.title: Dev Blog 15
notes.content: [p]The Snow Plow Project just hit a major milestone with the introduction of a cutting-edge, physics-based snow simulation that brings realistic snow pile-up, resistance, and interaction to the game. Developed with the help of a simulation expert, this system transforms gameplay, making snow clearing feel authentic and dynamic. Alongside this, the open-world region of Fields has expanded, assets are progressing, Screenshot Fridays showcase the latest visuals, and the soundtrack evolves with immersive ambient music. The project is steadily growing into a top-tier simulation experience.[/p][p]Curious to read more? [url="https://snowplowproject.com/en-cad/pages/dev-blog-15-the-road-to-real-snow"]https://snowplowproject.com/pages/dev-blog-15-the-road-to-real-snow[/url][/p]

notes.title: Dev Blog 14
notes.content:
Now that the open world mechanics are in place for this upcoming initial Alpha version, we've been populating the first sector with buildings, props, roads and vegetation, while the snow system is also being overhauled to make snow event more believable and realistic.

This Dev Blog sums up the year and takes a look at what's coming up on this road to an alpha version.

To read the full post, click this link: https://snowplowproject.com/en-cad/pages/dev-blog-14-fields

notes.title: Dev Blog 13
notes.content:
Our game is getting major changes. The playtest we’ve been running for more than a year now served well as a prototype or tech demo. For most of last summer, from a development point of view, I’ve been working on basically building a brand-new game out of the best of the playtest. In other words, the playtest that you know right now won’t be getting any more update. It has served its purpose.

This “new” build will be the Alpha version, or if you prefer, version 0.1.0. I took this opportunity to migrate the whole game to the most up-to-date Unity 3D engine. This opens the door to many technological improvements. The codes, mechanics and assets that were a success in the playtest are being ported to the Alpha, with most of this porting already completed. The playtest was only a start, we're only building from it now.

In this Dev Blog, we'll talk about the work in progress for this upcoming alpha: vehicle interiors and first person view, world layout, performance, and much more. Have a read at the Dev Blog to learn everything:

[url=https://snowplowproject.com/en-cad/pages/dev-blog-13-alpha]https://snowplowproject.com/en-cad/pages/dev-blog-13-alpha[/url]

notes.title: Dev Blog 12
notes.content:
Development has shifted. To what?

We're slowly moving away from the sandbox, and now focusing on the open world and the next game modes. Thanks to the playtest that has been running for about 16 months now, we have a better idea of what works and what doesn't, and this data guides us in the development of what's coming. We are now building a magnificient wintery county and enhancing the existing mechanics. Sooner than later, you'll have a whole new world to plow. In the meantime, have a read at Dev Blog 12. Cheers!

https://www.snowplowproject.com/dev-blog-12-the-shift/

notes.title: Dev Blog 11
notes.content:
In almost a year since the announcement of the game on Steam and the launch of the playtest, we kept working hard on the project while allowing thousands of playtesters to try the first version of it. Major mechanics have been implemented and upgraded, and we're slowly going towards something more complete and enjoyable. Here's the latest Dev Blog if you're curious to see what's happening. In this blog, we'll have an overview of what has been done in the last year and what's to come.

https://www.snowplowproject.com/dev-blog-11-2022-wrap-up/
